details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .claude/commands/fix-claude-pr.md:step 5 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: When a Claude-asset sync merge conflicts only outside `.claude/`, the procedure aborts the merge and continues the privileged fix on the unsynced head under stale guards.
  WHY: This reintroduces the security gap the sync is meant to prevent; all reviewers rate it MAJOR.
- .claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md:185 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The shared Claude-asset sync procedure allows PR-head callers in steps 7 and 7a to continue fixes after an outside-`.claude/` conflict, potentially under stale guards.
  WHY: Blocked interventions and review-round fixes can proceed on an unsynced head; reviewers rate it MAJOR.
- .claude/hooks/session-start.sh:255-256 | severity=low | confidence=[2]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: Default-branch resolution can fall back to `main` when `origin/HEAD` is unset or the `git ls-remote --symref` output is not matched, causing the drift check to use the wrong branch or silently skip reporting.
  WHY: In repositories with a non-`main` default branch, the diagnostic may miss drift or report against an unrelated stale `main` ref; reviewers rate this NIT.
- .claude/hooks/session-start.sh:237-277 | severity=low | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: `report_claude_assets_drift` adds a bounded network call that can delay Claude Code Web session start by up to 15 seconds.
  WHY: The reviewer describes the call as intentional, bounded, and fail-open, but notes the operational latency risk.
- tests/test_claude_asset_sync_command.py:`test_documented_merge_and_settings_commands_behave_as_described` | severity=low | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The tests cover the documented merge success path but do not exercise the `.claude/**`-conflict abort path.
  WHY: A regression that omits `git merge --abort` on a `.claude/` conflict could pass CI.
- agents.md:≈lines 1162–1185 | severity=low | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The Claude-asset sync bullet claims all callers use the `[claude-asset-sync]` commit subject, while the project-branch sync retains `[claude-merge-resolve]`.
  WHY: The documentation contradicts the documented step 2 behavior and could mislead future tooling or readers.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: From the source issue #4952 (per `docs/plans/issue-4952-sync-claude-assets-at-session-start-plan.md`): when the Claude-asset sync merge conflicts under `.claude/`, abort and stop with a precise blocker; the blocker must name the conflicting files and the commits on each side, and must not silently run the fix under stale guards. The linked audit finding #5258 (`asset-sync-outside-conflict-fail-open`, A05:2021) explicitly extends this requirement to outside-`.claude/` conflicts: "no fixer (`/fix-claude-pr`, `/implement-plan-claude` steps 7 and 7a) continues on the unsynced head", and "such a conflict is resolved inside the sync merge under the caller's conflict rules, keeping both sides' intent, and committed with the sync merge's documented subject."
  expected_change_site: `.claude/commands/fix-claude-pr.md` step 5 and `.claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md` `### Claude-asset sync` step 5, plus their `workflow-templates/.claude/commands/` twins
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: Both sentences allowing continuation after outside-`.claude/` conflicts remain in the command text and twins; the #5258 plan's AD-1/AD-2/AD-5 describes the required replacement, while the implement-plan log is `Status: IN_PROGRESS`, `Stage: phase 1/1`, `Waiting on: none`; the `changelog.d/5258-asset-sync-outside-conflict-fail-closed.md` fragment is also absent.
- requirement: From the `## Implementation Steps` of `docs/plans/issue-5258-asset-sync-outside-conflict-fail-closed-plan.md`: "3. `tests/test_claude_asset_sync_command.py`: add twin-only contract tests (the rule text in both twins, the removed 'continues on the unsynced head' wording), plus a scratch-repository test." The plan also calls for a `agents.md` update of the Claude-asset sync bullet (step 4) and the new `changelog.d/5258-asset-sync-outside-conflict-fail-closed.md` fragment (step 5).
  expected_change_site: `tests/test_claude_asset_sync_command.py`, `agents.md`, and `changelog.d/5258-asset-sync-outside-conflict-fail-closed.md`
  confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: The test file contains only the success-path merge test and #4952 rule-text assertions, with no negative-text assertion or scratch-repository conflict-resolution test; the specified changelog fragment is absent.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- .claude/commands/fix-claude-pr.md:46 | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: A conflict only outside `.claude/` aborts the sync merge and the fix continues on the unsynced head, so the privileged fix runs under outdated guard hooks.
  WHY: The guard fix may be absent during the privileged fix, allowing commits or edits that current guards would reject.
- .claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md:185 | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: PR-head callers in step 7 and step 7a may proceed to fix on an unsynced head after an outside-`.claude/` conflict.
  WHY: The fix or intervention may run under outdated hooks.
- .claude/hooks/session-start.sh:255-256 | severity=low | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: The `git ls-remote --symref origin HEAD` parsing may fail to match an unexpected separator and leave `default_branch` empty, causing fallback to `main`.
  WHY: The hook may compute drift against the wrong branch when the actual default branch is not `main`.
- .claude/hooks/session-start.sh:237-277 | severity=low | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: `report_claude_assets_drift` introduces a bounded 15-second network call on every Claude Code Web session start.
  WHY: This adds operational latency of up to 15 seconds if the fetch stalls, though errors are handled and the behavior is documented and intentional.
=== END FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- .claude/commands/fix-claude-pr.md:step 5 — "A conflict only outside `.claude/` aborts the sync merge and the fix continues on the unsynced head." | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: An outside-`.claude/` conflict allows the privileged fix to continue on the unsynced head under a partial guard set.
  WHY: Subsequent claim, merge base, edit, verify, and push steps run without the complete guard set the sync is intended to provide.
- .claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md:"### Claude-asset sync" step 5 | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The shared procedure allows steps 7 and 7a to continue a blocker or review-round fix after an outside-`.claude/` conflict.
  WHY: The next fix steps run against a partial guard set instead of resolving the conflict inside the sync merge.
- tests/test_claude_asset_sync_command.py:`test_documented_merge_and_settings_commands_behave_as_described` | severity=low | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: Tests cover the success path but not the `.claude/**`-conflict abort path or the outside-`.claude/` abort path.
  WHY: A regression that omits `git merge --abort` on a `.claude/` conflict would be caught only after a real conflict reaches production.
- .claude/hooks/session-start.sh:`report_claude_assets_drift` — the `[ -n "${default_branch}" ] || default_branch="main"` fallback | severity=low | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: When `origin/HEAD` is unset and the bounded `ls-remote --symref` attempt returns nothing, the hook hard-codes `main` as the default branch.
  WHY: A stale `main` ref after a default-branch rename can produce a false `claude_assets=stale` report and trigger an unrelated merge.
- agents.md:≈lines 1162–1185 | severity=low | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The new bullet says all sync callers use `[claude-asset-sync]`, but project-branch sync keeps `[claude-merge-resolve]`.
  WHY: The contradiction may cause future log analyzers or scripts relying on the claimed subject to miss project-branch syncs.
